newsitem.title: USA: Gencor okays boost in outstanding to 15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gencor okays boost in outstanding to 15 mln.

text.p: Gencor Industries Inc said Tuesday its shareholders approved an increase in the number of outstanding common shares to 15 million from five million.
"This is to allow Gencor to have more flexibility to use equity as we position the company for significant growth," E.J. Elliott, Gencor's chairman said in a statement.
As to any future acquisitions, Elliott said the company must keep all options opens. Gencor recently acquired Consolidated Process Machinery from Ingersoll-Rand Co.
"Gencor must be ready to act when a possibility arises that allows us to expand in a way that is cost effective and synergistic to our existing core business," Elliott said.
Gencor, based in Orlando, is a manufacturer of asphalt plants in the United States.
